The identifier is derived deterministically from the household's identity 26 * (last name, canonicalized by {@link HouseholdNormalizer}, and postcode), so every 27 * owner sharing a last name and postcode resolves to the same value automatically, 28 * regardless of registration order. 29 */ 30 @Component 31 public class HouseholdIdGenerator { 32 33 private static final int ID_LENGTH = 12; 34 35 private final HouseholdNormalizer householdNormalizer; 36 37 public HouseholdIdGenerator(HouseholdNormalizer householdNormalizer) { 38 this.householdNormalizer = householdNormalizer; 39 } 40 41 /** 42 * Build the household identifier shared by owners with the given last name and 43 * postcode: the first {@value #ID_LENGTH} upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over 44 * {@code normalize(lastName) + "|" + postcode}. 45 * 46 * @param lastName the household's last name 47 * @param postcode the household's postcode 48 * @return a stable, upper-case hexadecimal identifier for the household 49 */ 50 public String generate(String lastName, String postcode) { 51 String key = householdNormalizer.normalize(lastName) + "|" + postcode; 52 return Sha256Hex.upperHexPrefix(key, ID_LENGTH); 53 } 54 } 55

Two values are considered the same household field when they match after 27 * trimming, collapsing every run of whitespace to a single space, and lower-casing. 28 * This is the comparison used to detect owners living in the same household. 29 */ 30 @Component 31 public class HouseholdNormalizer { 32 33 /** 34 * Reduce {@code value} to its canonical form for case-insensitive, 35 * whitespace-insensitive comparison. 36 * 37 * @param value the raw field value (may be {@code null}) 38 * @return the normalized value, or an empty string when {@code value} is {@code null} 39 */ 40 public String normalize(String value) { 41 if (value == null) { 42 return ""; 43 } 44 return value.strip().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT); 45 } 46 } 47

2090:          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
2107:          description: Deprecated and ignored. Household membership (same last name and postcode) is no longer rejected as a duplicate; duplicate detection is now based solely on the identityKey, and owners sharing a soundex(lastName) and postcode with a different identityKey are flagged as a soft match rather than rejected. Input only; not stored.
2116:    Owner:

2161:            memberId:
2163:              description: The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the '<REGION><FY><HASH8>' prefix.
2167:            householdId:
2169:              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household, derived deterministically as the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode ('normalizedLastName|postcode'). Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Absent when no postcode was supplied.
2204:            locality:
2206:              description: The owner's locality, being the region code that leads the memberId, resolved from the postcode (preferred, matched against the known region ranges) falling back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
2210:            timezone:
2212:              description: The owner's timezone, being the IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality has no known timezone.
2217:              title: Owner segment
2218:              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
2243:            identityKey:
2245:              description: The single derived value all duplicate detection is based on, the lower-case SHA-256 hex digest over normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + soundex(lastName). A new owner is rejected as a duplicate only when its whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
2263:              description: True when this owner was flagged at creation as a possible (soft) duplicate of an existing owner; otherwise false. Raised when an existing owner shares this owner's soundex(lastName) and postcode but has a different identityKey (for example a different telephone), so the two are not a hard duplicate. summary:
I have gathered a complete picture. Here is my report on the "owner identity" feature.

## Overview

This is a Spring PetClinic REST app. The owner-identity derivations live as `@Transient` getters on the `Owner` entity, backed by small helper/model classes and two `@Component` generators. The API response shape is defined in an OpenAPI spec (`openapi.yml`) from which DTOs are code-generated; audit is emitted via a dedicated logger + immutable record. There is already an acceptance test that pins the desired **v2** contract (nested `identity` object + `apiVersion: 2`), and a partially-built `v2` layer (currently only a paged-list endpoint).

---

## 1. Owner entity — the identity getters (region, householdId, identityKey, memberId, locality, timezone, segment)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`

Key stored columns: `memberId` (line 70-71), `householdId` (73-74). Key derived `@Transient` getters:
- `getMemberId()` (211) — stored, doc at 205-210: format `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`.
- `getHouseholdId()` (219) — stored.
- `getLocality()` (522-525): `return LocalityResolver.regionFor(this.postcode, this.city);`
- `getTimezone()` (532-535): `return LocalityResolver.timezoneFor(getLocality());`
- `getOwnerSegment()` (543-546): `return OwnerSegment.of(getMembershipLevel(), getLocality());`
- `getIdentityKey()` (556-560):
```java
String core = keyPart(this.telephone) + "|" + keyPart(this.email) + "|" + Soundex.encode(this.getLastName());
return Sha256Hex.lowerHex(core);
```
(`keyPart` renders null as `""`, lines 562-564.)
- Also relevant: `getMembershipLevel()` (443-450), `getMembershipPoints()` (420-436), `getFiscalYear()` (192-195), `getAgeBand()` (508-514), `getPossibleDuplicate()`/`getRiskFlag()` (303-320).

## 2. Locality & timezone resolution (region code, ranges, timezone table)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/LocalityResolver.java`

- `UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"` (30).
- `CITY_REGIONS` (32-35): Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD.
- `REGION_RANGES` (38-41): NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099.
- `REGION_TIMEZONES` (44-47): NSW→Australia/Sydney, VIC→Australia/Melbourne, QLD→Australia/Brisbane.
- `regionFor(postcode, city)` (60-63) prefers postcode; `regionForCity`, `isKnownRegion`, `timezoneFor`, `rangeForRegion`, and private `regionForPostcode`.

## 3. Owner segment derivation

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/OwnerSegment.java`

`of(membershipLevel, locality)` returns `<TIER>_<AREA>` where TIER = `PREMIUM` if level ≥ 3 (`PREMIUM_MIN_LEVEL`) else `STANDARD`; AREA = `METRO` if `LocalityResolver.isKnownRegion(locality)` else `REGIONAL`.

## 4. Identifier generators & crypto/helper primitives

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/MemberIdGenerator.java` — `generate(region, telephone, lastName, registrationDate)`: `HASH8 = Sha256Hex.upperHexPrefix(telephone + lastName, 8)`, `base = String.format("%s%02d%s", region, FiscalYear.of(date).getShortYear(), hash8)`, returns `base + LuhnCheckDigit.of(base)`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/HouseholdIdGenerator.java` — `generate(lastName, postcode)`: `Sha256Hex.upperHexPrefix(normalize(lastName) + "|" + postcode, 12)` (`ID_LENGTH = 12`).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/HouseholdNormalizer.java` — `normalize`: strip, collapse whitespace, lowercase (ROOT).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Sha256Hex.java` — `lowerHex(input)` (full 64-char lower hex) and `upperHexPrefix(input, length)` (upper-cased prefix).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Soundex.java` — `encode(name)` → 4-char Soundex, `""` when no letters.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/LuhnCheckDigit.java` — `of(s)` Luhn check digit over digits only.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/FiscalYear.java` — used for FY segment (`getShortYear()`, `getLabel()`, `yearsUntil`). (Referenced; not printed above but at that path.)

Note: `MemberIdGenerator` is a `@Component` but is **not** wired into the create flow shown in the V1 controller — the stored `memberId` column exists and is documented; `getMemberId()` simply returns the stored value. Worth confirming where `setMemberId` is called when you build v2 (I did not find a call site in `OwnerRestControllerV1`).

## 5. Audit event / audit logging (schemaVersion is NOT yet present)

Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, being '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, being the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for human display, being the calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the '<REGION><FY><HASH8>' prefix.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household, derived deterministically as the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode ('normalizedLastName|postcode'). Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Absent when no postcode was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of owners that already existed at the moment this owner was created sharing the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively). Captured once at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends (e.g. 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 is 'FY26'). Absent when no registrationDate is known.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, starting at 0; add 2 when an email address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for qualifying tenure (more than 1 elapsed fiscal year since registration).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, being the region code that leads the memberId, resolved from the postcode (preferred, matched against the known region ranges) falling back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's timezone, being the IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, being 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate as of the registrationDate, being 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived value all duplicate detection is based on, the lower-case SHA-256 hex digest over normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + soundex(lastName). A new owner is rejected as a duplicate only when its whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been registered on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created (an unusually high-volume signup day); otherwise false. Captured once at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners when this owner was created, flagging that the city is approaching its capacity limit of 50; otherwise false. Captured once at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner was flagged at creation as a possible (soft) duplicate of an existing owner; otherwise false. Raised when an existing owner shares this owner's soundex(lastName) and postcode but has a different identityKey (for example a different telephone), so the two are not a hard duplicate. Captured once at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible (soft) duplicate of at creation, or absent when it is not a possible duplicate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when this owner warrants review because any risk signal holds - the owner is a possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (closely related to a known disposable-email provider without being one, such as a subdomain of it or the same label under a different suffix), or its city was over its soft capacity (the capacity-warning band of 40 to 49 owners) when the owner was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. False for a newly created owner; set true when the owner is deleted, which retains the record rather than removing it.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

                <groupId>org.openapitools</groupId>
                <artifactId>openapi-generator-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <!-- RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <version>${maven.openapi-generator-plugin.version}</version>
                <!-- /RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>generate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/openapi.yml</inputSpec>
                            <generatorName>spring</generatorName>
                            <library>spring-boot</library>

                            <!-- Only enabling model andopenapi-generator-maven-plugin API generation -->
                            <modelNameSuffix>Dto</modelNameSuffix>
                            <apiPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.api</apiPackage>
                            <generateModels>true</generateModels>
                            <modelPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto</modelPackage>
                            <generateApis>true</generateApis>
                            <importMappings>
                                <importMapping>Nullable=org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable</importMapping>
                            </importMappings>
                            <configOptions>
                                <!-- RestController implementation is provided by Petclinic developers -->
                                <interfaceOnly>true</interfaceOnly>
                                <!-- Generate API interfaces from OpenAPI tags -->
                                <useTags>true</useTags>
                                <!-- Activating Java 8 features -->
                                <performBeanValidation>true</performBeanValidation>
                                <useSpringBoot3>true</useSpringBoot3>
                                <useJakartaEe>true</useJakartaEe>
                                <openApiNullable>false</openApiNullable>
                                <!-- override the default library to jersey2 -->
                                <serializationLibrary>jackson</serializationLibrary>
                                <!-- switch documentation provider to springdoc -->
                                <documentationProvider>springdoc</documentationProvider>
                            </configOptions>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                <artifactId>build-helper-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>add-source</id>
                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>add-source</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <sources>
                                <source>target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java</source>
                            </sources>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). Optional. When present it is combined with the last name to form the salutation.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On output it is the
            composed, normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is
            present, or the normalized flat address when only the flat form was given.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized like the flat address on create.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or suite). Normalized like the flat address on create and, when
            present, appended to 'addressLine1' in the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on input; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it is used to derive the ageBand relative to the registrationDate. Returned in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Deprecated and ignored. Household membership (same last name and postcode) is no longer rejected as a duplicate; duplicate detection is now based solely on the identityKey, and owners sharing a soundex(lastName) and postcode with a different identityKey are flagged as a soft match rather than rejected. Input only; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, being '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, being the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for human display, being the calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the '<REGION><FY><HASH8>' prefix.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household, derived deterministically as the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode ('normalizedLastName|postcode'). Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Absent when no postcode was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of owners that already existed at the moment this owner was created sharing the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively). Captured once at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends (e.g. 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 is 'FY26'). Absent when no registrationDate is known.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, starting at 0; add 2 when an email address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for qualifying tenure (more than 1 elapsed fiscal year since registration).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, being the region code that leads the memberId, resolved from the postcode (preferred, matched against the known region ranges) falling back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's timezone, being the IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, being 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate as of the registrationDate, being 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived value all duplicate detection is based on, the lower-case SHA-256 hex digest over normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + soundex(lastName). A new owner is rejected as a duplicate only when its whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been registered on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created (an unusually high-volume signup day); otherwise false. Captured once at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners when this owner was created, flagging that the city is approaching its capacity limit of 50; otherwise false. Captured once at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner was flagged at creation as a possible (soft) duplicate of an existing owner; otherwise false. Raised when an existing owner shares this owner's soundex(lastName) and postcode but has a different identityKey (for example a different telephone), so the two are not a hard duplicate. Captured once at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible (soft) duplicate of at creation, or absent when it is not a possible duplicate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when this owner warrants review because any risk signal holds - the owner is a possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (closely related to a known disposable-email provider without being one, such as a subdomain of it or the same label under a different suffix), or its city was over its soft capacity (the capacity-warning band of 40 to 49 owners) when the owner was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. False for a newly created owner; set true when the owner is deleted, which retains the record rather than removing it.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30

        birthDate:
          title: Birth date

          type: string
          format: date

        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1

            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"

        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"

        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:

      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: >-
            Optional client-supplied key that makes the create idempotent. A repeated
            request carrying a key already seen returns the originally created owner
            instead of creating a duplicate.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: The pet owner already existed for the supplied Idempotency-Key.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

    delete:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: deleteOwner
      summary: Delete an owner by ID
      description: Returns the owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner  not found.
          content:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). Optional. When present it is combined with the last name to form the salutation.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On output it is the
            composed, normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is
            present, or the normalized flat address when only the flat form was given.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized like the flat address on create.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or suite). Normalized like the flat address on create and, when
            present, appended to 'addressLine1' in the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on input; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it is used to derive the ageBand relative to the registrationDate. Returned in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Deprecated and ignored. Household membership (same last name and postcode) is no longer rejected as a duplicate; duplicate detection is now based solely on the identityKey, and owners sharing a soundex(lastName) and postcode with a different identityKey are flagged as a soft match rather than rejected. Input only; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, being '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, being the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for human display, being the calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of this owner identity representation. Always 2.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Identity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of owners that already existed at the moment this owner was created sharing the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively). Captured once at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends (e.g. 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 is 'FY26'). Absent when no registrationDate is known.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, starting at 0; add 2 when an email address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for qualifying tenure (more than 1 elapsed fiscal year since registration).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, being the region code that leads the memberId, resolved from the postcode (preferred, matched against the known region ranges) falling back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's timezone, being the IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, being 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate as of the registrationDate, being 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived value all duplicate detection is based on, the lower-case SHA-256 hex digest over normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + soundex(lastName). A new owner is rejected as a duplicate only when its whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been registered on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created (an unusually high-volume signup day); otherwise false. Captured once at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners when this owner was created, flagging that the city is approaching its capacity limit of 50; otherwise false. Captured once at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner was flagged at creation as a possible (soft) duplicate of an existing owner; otherwise false. Raised when an existing owner shares this owner's soundex(lastName) and postcode but has a different identityKey (for example a different telephone), so the two are not a hard duplicate. Captured once at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible (soft) duplicate of at creation, or absent when it is not a possible duplicate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when this owner warrants review because any risk signal holds - the owner is a possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (closely related to a known disposable-email provider without being one, such as a subdomain of it or the same label under a different suffix), or its city was over its soft capacity (the capacity-warning band of 40 to 49 owners) when the owner was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. False for a newly created owner; set true when the owner is deleted, which retains the record rather than removing it.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object

          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.

          content:
